title: The Right Words at the Right Moment
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Choose the right Turkish phrase, with its pronunciation guide, in ten everyday Istanbul situations, ending with a phrase sheet for the trip.

educational.topic: The Right Words at the Right Moment
learningObjectives: Use the appropriate Turkish phrase in ten everyday situations from our Istanbul days, choosing the best phrase in at least 8 of 10 situations on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Basic Turkish phrases and their meanings
Turkish pronunciation of c, ç, ş, ğ and ı

keyQuestions: Who says this phrase, and to whom?
commonMisconceptions: Ne kadar? is how to ask for the bill.
Afiyet olsun is what the diner says to the cook.
Hoş geldiniz is answered with Hoş geldiniz.
Teşekkür ederim fits every situation, so the others are unnecessary.
Greeting a working person is an interruption.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score on ten situations (mastery: 8 of 10).
Count how many wrong choices were the other person's phrase.
